name: tessera-mono
description: A neoretro bitmap monospace font — 8×16 px cell, designed to carry the full Nerd Fonts glyphset

scripts.build:otb: npm run check && for s in 1 2 3; do node scripts/build-bdf.mjs --scale $s --output dist/TesseraMono-${s}x.bdf && fonttosfnt -o dist/TesseraMono-${s}x.otb dist/TesseraMono-${s}x.bdf; done
scripts.build:otb-multi: npm run check && for s in 1 2 3; do node scripts/build-bdf.mjs --scale $s --output dist/TesseraMono-${s}x.bdf; done && fonttosfnt -o dist/TesseraMono.otb dist/TesseraMono-1x.bdf dist/TesseraMono-2x.bdf dist/TesseraMono-3x.bdf
scripts.edit: npm run build:font && npm run edit:bdf && gbdfed dist/TesseraMono-edit.bdf && npm run edit:import && npm run build:font
scripts.build: npm run build:font && mkdir -p public && cp index.html public/ && cp -r src public/ && mkdir -p public/dist && cp dist/TesseraMono-Regular.ttf public/dist/ && cp OFL.txt public/ && touch public/.nojekyll
